fields.title: Four tabs: Library, Newsroom, Podcasts, Marketplace
fields.description: The app gets four top-level tabs. Library is the home for all books. Newsroom is the home for all articles and periodicals (saved articles, RSS feeds and the like). Podcasts and Marketplace show a "Coming Soon" banner. Library and Newsroom are built now; this item is the tab shell, the two banners, and moving articles out of the book library into Newsroom without losing positions, highli
